page.layout: One text column in the centre of the left printed page, with a narrow left margin holding one note (aligned with the line "referente q Nicephoro"). Right of the text is the edge of the neighbouring page, which is not transcribed.

main_text.p: Non accepi arma, non sumpsi lanceas, non arripui scutum, solummodo often-di pulchritudinem meam, qua perspecta vulnerati fugerunt.] Neque aliud invenire est in eius Epistolis ab exilio missis, sive ad Episcopos & Presbyteros ob pietatem in carcere inclusos; sive ad Olympiam foeminam cum primis illustrem, sive ad Innocentium Pontificem Romanum & Episcopos Occidentales, qui facile Honorium Occidentis Imperatorem, & Christi studiosissimum, ad arma in fratrem Arcadium capienda excitassent, si suasisset Chrysostomus. Imo ipse Innocentius Romanus Pontifex (refe-q Ii'.13. cap.32.rente q Nicephoro) Chrysostomo hunc in modum rescribit. [Ex literis dilectionis vestrae, quas per Germanum Presbyterum & Cassianum [?] Diaconum ad nos dedistis, scenam malorum quam ob oculos posuistis, amica sollicitudine cognovi, & quibus aerumnis malisque fides laboret, repetita saepius lectione perspexi. Cui rei sola patientię consolatio medetur; dabit enim breui Deus noster afflictionibus tantis finem; quas sustinu-isse proderit.] Idem tamen Nicephorus,

page.notes: Left-margin note "q Ii'.13. cap.32." is placed at the line where "rente" begins. The italic setting of several names (Honorius, Germanum Presbyterum, Nicephoro) is uncertain and is based on the scan. "Cassianum" is uncertain, and the first letter may be a long s. The final catchword "ejusdem" is removed from the text. The bracket "]" closing at "fugerunt." is printed as shown.
